import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top Products by Revenue
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(8)
axes[0, 0].barh(range(len(product_revenue)), product_revenue.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_yticks(range(len(product_revenue)))
axes[0, 0].set_yticklabels(product_revenue.index)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top 8 Products by Revenue', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
for i, v in enumerate(product_revenue.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v, i, f' ${v:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group and Payment Method
age_payment = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().unstack()
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_payment = age_payment.reindex(age_order)
age_payment.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 1], stacked=True, 
                 color=['#D2691E', '#8B4513', '#A0522D', '#CD853F'])
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Revenue by Age Group and Payment Method', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Payment Method', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(age_order, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Takeaway vs Dine-in Analysis
takeaway_stats = df.groupby('is_takeaway').agg({
    'total': ['sum', 'count']
}).reset_index()
takeaway_stats.columns = ['is_takeaway', 'revenue', 'count']
takeaway_stats['is_takeaway'] = takeaway_stats['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'})

x = np.arange(len(takeaway_stats))
width = 0.35
ax3_twin = axes[1, 0].twinx()

bars1 = axes[1, 0].bar(x - width/2, takeaway_stats['revenue'], width, 
                        label='Revenue', color='#8B4513', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax3_twin.bar(x + width/2, takeaway_stats['count'], width, 
                      label='Transactions', color='#D2691E', alpha=0.8)

axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Service Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#8B4513')
ax3_twin.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#D2691E')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Comparison', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(x)
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(takeaway_stats['is_takeaway'])
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#8B4513')
ax3_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#D2691E')
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels
for bar in bars1:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                    f'${height:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)
for bar in bars2:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3_twin.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                  f'{int(height)}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# Create combined legend
lines1, labels1 = axes[1, 0].get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax3_twin.get_legend_handles_labels()
axes[1, 0].legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper left')

# 4. Average Transaction Value by Size
size_avg = df.groupby('size').agg({
    'total': 'mean',
    'quantity': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_avg['size'] = pd.Categorical(size_avg['size'], categories=size_order, ordered=True)
size_avg = size_avg.sort_values('size')

colors_size = ['#DEB887', '#CD853F', '#8B4513']
bars = axes[1, 1].bar(size_avg['size'], size_avg['total'], color=colors_size, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Product Size', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Transaction Value by Product Size', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

for bar, qty in zip(bars, size_avg['total']):
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 1].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                    f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
